nonblocking_findings.title: Source discrimination is substring-based, not path-component membership
nonblocking_findings.reproducer: SOURCE only: compile an init_agent function at /synthetic/source-foreign/control.py, /synthetic/source2/control.py or /elsewhere/synthetic/source/control.py while source=/synthetic/source; invoke and catch RuntimeError.
nonblocking_findings.observed: All three unrelated functions produce forbidden-sink/init_agent and no body execution under the replacement. Baseline sys.setprofile also falsely classifies the first such path; after its callback raises it stops profiling, so the two subsequent bodies run. The false-positive path classification is inherited, not a new sink bypass.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Potential false refusal if foreign code has a colliding filename. Normal /foreign/control.py is correctly ignored. Approval does not certify exact root-boundary discrimination or hostile co_filename provenance.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Parent may defer this inherited nonblocking limitation. If repaired separately, use a shared component-bounded source predicate before frame access and retain prefix/nested-foreign negative controls. Do not enlarge this fixture repair into a new verifier project.

requirements.requirement: Guard records veto before raising, even when caller catches it
requirements.evidence: Each interpreter recorded 120 forbidden sink attempts across 10 original names, 4 roots, two sequential calls and one new-thread call per code object; all body counters remained zero and child exits were zero after catching exceptions. Parent reader independently rejects forbidden-* rows. Direct synthetic calls to the actual timed_audit/audit body recorded all three forbidden effect event tags despite caught exceptions; no socket, subprocess sink or system call was performed.
requirements.limit: Emitter short-write handling is retained at lines63-68; this was statically inspected, not failure-injected on a real evidence FD. Python observers are not OS confinement.

requirements.requirement: Original forbidden function inventory, start/normal return and threads
requirements.evidence: All ten original forbidden names retained. Both interpreters also denied all ten async first-start and all ten generator first-start synthetic functions, with zero body execution. Normal contract-guard and bound-predicates returns and run_handler starts were observed both on main and newly created threads (six expected rows, six body executions per interpreter). A thread created before observer registration was also denied when it later invoked init_agent.
requirements.limit: First PY_START and normal PY_RETURN semantics only; no claim about prestarted resumable frames, abnormal unwind accounting, native C functions, deliberate observer removal or subinterpreters.

requirements.requirement: Early filtering and DISABLE cache safety
requirements.evidence: Current SOURCE pytest unrelated and ordinary foreign cases require exactly zero frame.f_code audit events. Independent cache control interleaved unobserved ordinary code, foreign init_agent and native init_agent twenty times, then repeated after restart_events: 21 recorded denials and 42 allowed bodies on each interpreter. DISABLE is returned only for unobserved code; original matching code stays enabled after guard exceptions.
requirements.reasoning: The predicate uses immutable code.co_name/co_filename against bootstrap-owned fixed observed/root sets, not frame-local data. Disabling one unobserved code/event does not suppress other observed code or later matching code objects.
requirements.limit: Assumes bootstrap-owned filter configuration is not deliberately mutated.

requirements.requirement: Missing observer API or occupied monitoring tool ID fails closed
requirements.evidence: Synthetic removal of sys.monitoring gives AttributeError/exit1 before READY; preoccupying PROFILER_ID gives ValueError/exit1 before READY, on both interpreters. Registration/set_events precede READY and uncaught setup errors precede run_module. Native parent requires READY. No fallback silently runs without observation.

requirements.requirement: No new output leakage; finite SOURCE controls
requirements.evidence: Added bootstrap data are fixed event tags, elapsed integer timings and audit counts. Synthetic private return markers in predicate_values/_contract_guard were absent from emitted rows (GAP/REFUSED projections). All successful probe children had empty stderr. The ten SOURCE pytest controls include sanitized diagnostic/phase/stderr controls. New observer children have 10-second subprocess timeouts and 2-second thread joins; child-only threads cannot outlive the bounded process.
requirements.limit: Does not extend approval to unchanged arbitrary release status fields, private native logs or deliberate pytest --showlocals/--showargs. No raw logs, runtime.boot, DSNs, capability values or credentials were read or emitted by this review.
